vtubestudio.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot connects to VTube Studio.

vtubestudio.disconnected.description: Runs when Cuebot loses its connection to VTube Studio, for example when you close it.

vtubestudio.modelLoaded.description: Runs when a model (your avatar) is loaded in VTube Studio.

fields.modelName: Only react to these models, typed by name. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any model.

variables.modelId: VTube Studio's id for the model

vtubestudio.modelUnloaded.description: Runs when the model (your avatar) is unloaded from VTube Studio.

variables.modelId: VTube Studio's id for the model

vtubestudio.hotkeyTriggered.description: Runs when a VTube Studio hotkey is used, for example to change an expression or play an animation.

fields.hotkeyName: Only react to these hotkeys, typed by name or id. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any hotkey.
fields.hotkeyAction: Only react to this kind of hotkey, like "ToggleExpression" or "TriggerAnimation". Leave empty for any kind.
fields.ignoreApi: Tick to ignore hotkeys that other programs (including Cuebot) triggered, so only hotkeys you press yourself count.

variables.hotkeyFile: The file the hotkey uses, if any
variables.triggeredByApi: True if another program triggered it
variables.modelName: The model it was used on

vtubestudio.trackingStatusChanged.description: Runs when VTube Studio's face or hand tracking changes (found or lost).

variables.faceFound: True if a face is being tracked
variables.leftHandFound: True if the left hand is tracked
variables.rightHandFound: True if the right hand is tracked

vtubestudio.trackingLost.description: Runs when VTube Studio can no longer see your face. Good for a "brb" reaction.

variables.faceFound: True if a face is being tracked
variables.leftHandFound: True if the left hand is tracked
variables.rightHandFound: True if the right hand is tracked

vtubestudio.trackingFound.description: Runs when VTube Studio sees your face again after losing it.

variables.faceFound: True if a face is being tracked
variables.leftHandFound: True if the left hand is tracked
variables.rightHandFound: True if the right hand is tracked

vtubestudio.backgroundChanged.description: Runs when you switch the background in VTube Studio.

fields.backgroundName: Only react to these backgrounds, typed by name. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any background.

variables.backgroundName: The name of the new background

vtubestudio.modelConfigChanged.description: Runs when the settings of the loaded model change in VTube Studio, for example when you edit its hotkeys.

variables.modelId: VTube Studio's id for the model
variables.hotkeyConfigChanged: True if the hotkey list changed

vtubestudio.modelMoved.description: Runs when the model is moved, turned or resized in VTube Studio.

variables.modelId: VTube Studio's id for the model
variables.positionX: Left to right position (-1 is left edge, 1 is right edge)
variables.positionY: Bottom to top position (-1 is bottom, 1 is top)
variables.rotation: How far it is turned, in degrees

vtubestudio.modelAnimation.description: Runs when an animation on the model starts, ends or sends a custom signal.

fields.animationEventType: Start reacts when an animation begins, End when it finishes, Custom for special signals set inside the animation, Any for all.
fields.animationName: Only react to these animations, typed by name. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any animation.
fields.ignoreIdle: Tick to ignore the animations the model plays by itself while doing nothing (idle animations).

variables.modelId: VTube Studio's id for the model
variables.animationLength: How long the animation lasts, in seconds
variables.isIdleAnimation: True if it is an idle animation

vtubestudio.itemEvent.description: Runs when something happens to an item (a prop or picture in your VTube Studio scene), like being added, removed or clicked.

fields.itemEventType: Which kind of thing to react to. Pick Any to react to all of them.
fields.itemFileName: Only react to these item files (the picture or prop file names, like "star.png"). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any item.

variables.itemEventType: What happened to the item: Added, Removed, Clicked and so on
variables.itemInstanceId: The id of this copy of the item
variables.itemX: Where the item is, left to right
variables.itemY: Where the item is, bottom to top

vtubestudio.itemAdded.description: Runs when an item (a prop or picture) is added to your VTube Studio scene.

fields.itemFileName: Only react to these item files (the picture or prop file names, like "star.png"). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any item.

variables.itemEventType: What happened to the item: Added, Removed, Clicked and so on
variables.itemInstanceId: The id of this copy of the item
variables.itemX: Where the item is, left to right
variables.itemY: Where the item is, bottom to top

vtubestudio.itemRemoved.description: Runs when an item (a prop or picture) is removed from your VTube Studio scene.

fields.itemFileName: Only react to these item files (the picture or prop file names, like "star.png"). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any item.

variables.itemEventType: What happened to the item: Added, Removed, Clicked and so on
variables.itemInstanceId: The id of this copy of the item
variables.itemX: Where the item is, left to right
variables.itemY: Where the item is, bottom to top

vtubestudio.modelClicked.description: Runs when someone clicks in the VTube Studio window, for example on your model.

fields.mouseButton: Only react to this mouse button, or pick Any.
fields.onlyOnModel: Tick to only react when the click lands on the model. Untick to react to clicks anywhere.

variables.modelId: VTube Studio's id for the model
variables.modelWasClicked: True if the click hit the model
variables.clickY: Where the click landed, up or down
variables.clickedArtMeshCount: How many parts of the model were hit

vtubestudio.expressionToggled.description: Runs when an expression (a face or pose preset) is switched on or off in VTube Studio.

fields.expressionName: Only react to these expressions, typed by name or file. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any expression.
fields.stateFilter: Pick On to react when it turns on, Off when it turns off, or Any for both.

variables.modelId: VTube Studio's id for the model
variables.active: True when the expression is now on

vtubestudio.postProcessingChanged.description: Runs when VTube Studio's post-processing (extra visual effects) is turned on or off or its preset changes.

variables.postProcessingPreset: The name of the preset in use

vtubestudio.event.description: Runs for any message VTube Studio sends, so you can react to things Cuebot has no special trigger for. For advanced users.

fields.eventName: Only react to these kinds of VTube Studio messages, like "ModelMovedEvent". Separate several with commas. Leave empty for all.

variables.eventName: The kind of VTube Studio message
variables.data: All the details of the message, as raw text

vtubestudio.triggerHotkey.description: Presses a VTube Studio hotkey for you, for example to play an animation or change an expression.

fields.hotkey: The hotkey name (or id) as VTube Studio shows it.
fields.itemInstanceId: Only for hotkeys that belong to a Live2D item you loaded: the id of that item. Most people can leave this empty.

variables.vtsHotkeyId: The id of the hotkey that was triggered

vtubestudio.loadModel.description: Switches VTube Studio to another model (avatar).

fields.model: The model name (or id) as VTube Studio shows it.

variables.vtsModelId: The id of the model that was loaded

vtubestudio.moveModel.description: Moves, turns or resizes your model on screen, smoothly.

fields.time: How long the move takes, in seconds (0 to 2).
fields.relative: Tick to move from where the model is now. Untick to put it at exactly the numbers below.
fields.positionX: Left to right: -1 is the left edge, 1 is the right edge. Leave empty to keep it.
fields.positionY: Bottom to top: -1 is the bottom, 1 is the top. Leave empty to keep it.
fields.rotation: How far to turn it, in degrees (-360 to 360). Leave empty to keep it.
fields.size: How big it is (-100 to 100). Leave empty to keep it.

vtubestudio.setExpression.description: Turns an expression (a face or pose preset) on or off.

fields.expression: The expression name or file as VTube Studio shows it.
fields.state: On turns it on, Off turns it off, Toggle flips it.
fields.fadeTime: How long the change takes, in seconds.

variables.vtsExpressionActive: True if the expression is on afterwards

vtubestudio.removeAllExpressions.description: Turns off every expression that is currently on.

fields.fadeTime: How long the change takes, in seconds.

vtubestudio.injectParameters.description: Moves parts of your model yourself, like head angle or mouth opening, as if your face did it. Handy for scripted reactions.

fields.parameters: What to move, as name=value, separated by commas or new lines, like "FaceAngleX=20, MouthOpen=1". Add @ and a number for how strongly, like "MouthOpen=1@0.5".
fields.mode: set replaces the value, add adds to what your face tracking is doing.
fields.holdSeconds: How long to keep the values applied, in seconds. Cuebot keeps re-sending them until the time is over.
fields.faceFound: Tick to tell VTube Studio a face was found, so it does not show "tracking lost" while Cuebot controls the model.

vtubestudio.colorTint.description: Tints your model with a color, for example red when someone is angry. Can tint all of it or only some parts.

fields.color: The color as a hex code like #FF8080, or as numbers like "255,128,128" (red, green, blue, and optional see-through).
fields.nameContains: Only tint parts whose names contain these words. Separate several with commas. Leave both boxes empty to tint everything.
fields.tagContains: Only tint parts whose tags contain these words. Separate several with commas.
fields.mix: How much the tint mixes with the scene lighting, from 0 to 1.

variables.vtsMatchedArtMeshes: How many parts of the model were tinted

vtubestudio.resetColorTint.description: Removes all color tints from your model.

vtubestudio.loadItem.description: Puts an item (a prop or picture) into your VTube Studio scene.

fields.fileName: The item's file name as VTube Studio shows it, like "star.png".
fields.positionX: Left to right position (-1 is the left edge, 1 is the right edge).
fields.positionY: Bottom to top position (-1 is the bottom, 1 is the top).
fields.size: How big it is, from 0 to 1.
fields.rotation: How far to turn it, in degrees.
fields.fadeTime: How long it takes to fade in, in seconds.
fields.order: Which layer it sits on, from -30 to 30. Leave empty to let VTube Studio pick a free one.
fields.unloadOnDisconnect: Tick to remove the item automatically if Cuebot disconnects from VTube Studio.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the item's id, so you can move or remove it later. The default is vtsItemInstanceId.

variables.vtsItemInstanceId: The id of the new item (or the name you chose above)

vtubestudio.unloadItem.description: Removes items (props or pictures) from your VTube Studio scene.

fields.item: The items to remove, by id or file name. Separate several with commas.
fields.all: Tick to remove every item in the scene.

vtubestudio.moveItem.description: Moves, turns or resizes an item in your scene, smoothly.

fields.item: The item to move: its id (from Load item) or its file name.
fields.time: How long the move takes, in seconds.
fields.fadeMode: How the motion feels: linear is steady, easeIn starts slow, easeOut ends slow, easeBoth does both, overshoot goes past and bounces back, zip is a quick snap.
fields.positionX: Left to right position (-1 is the left edge, 1 is the right edge). Leave empty to keep it.
fields.positionY: Bottom to top position (-1 is the bottom, 1 is the top). Leave empty to keep it.
fields.size: How big it is, from 0 to 1. Leave empty to keep it.
fields.rotation: How far to turn it, in degrees. Leave empty to keep it.

vtubestudio.getCurrentModel.description: Reads which model is loaded and where it is, and keeps the details for later steps.

variables.vtsModelLoaded: True if a model is loaded

vtubestudio.getModels.description: Reads the list of models you have in VTube Studio and keeps it for later steps.

variables.vtsModels: All model names, separated by commas
variables.vtsModelsJson: The full list as raw text

vtubestudio.getHotkeys.description: Reads the hotkeys of the loaded model and keeps them for later steps.

variables.vtsHotkeys: All hotkey names, separated by commas
variables.vtsHotkeysJson: The full list as raw text

vtubestudio.getExpressions.description: Reads the expressions of the loaded model and which ones are on, and keeps them for later steps.

variables.vtsExpressions: All expression names, separated by commas
variables.vtsActiveExpressions: The names of the expressions that are on now
variables.vtsExpressionsJson: The full list as raw text

vtubestudio.rawRequest.description: Sends VTube Studio one request of your own and keeps the answer. For advanced users who know the VTube Studio plugin commands.

fields.messageType: The VTube Studio request name, like "SceneColorOverlayInfoRequest".
fields.data: Extra details for the request, written as a JSON object. Leave empty if it needs none.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the answer as text. The default is vtsResult.
fields.variablePrefix: Also keeps each part of the answer as its own variable starting with this word, like %vtsRaw.data.modelName%. Leave empty to skip.

variables.vtsResult: The whole answer as raw text (or the name you chose above)
